text: The Eddlestone dog trials concluded on Saturday with a whippet taking best in show, according to the event’s official catalogue and judge’s report released by the Eddlestone Agricultural Society. The winning dog, Bracken of Lowmere, owned by Ms. Helena Prior of West Arun, edged out 148 other entrants in the final ring after judges cited its “exceptional stride, balance and calm ring presence.” The society said the breed’s victory was the first for a whippet in the trial’s 12-year history. Ms. Prior told The Continental Record she had trained Bracken “for field work and temperament alike.” The final judging was overseen by Mr. Cedric Vale, a licensed steward with the National Canine Register.
